aboutGame.title: What is Project Slayers?
paragraphs: Project Slayers is a Demon Slayer-inspired action RPG on Roblox created by Ouw Productions. Players step into a sprawling open world where they choose their path as a Human, Demon, or Slayer, mastering distinct combat stances like Breathing Styles and Blood Demon Arts while completing quests, challenging powerful bosses, and uncovering secrets.

Whether you are learning your first Water or Thunder form, rolling for a Supreme Clan like Kamado or Agatsuma, or farming endgame boss drops with your allies, our wiki provides complete guides, stat breakdowns, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Project Slayers.

items.question: What is Project Slayers?
items.answer: Project Slayers is a popular Roblox anime action RPG inspired by Demon Slayer. Players explore an open world, train Breathing Styles or Blood Demon Arts, unlock powerful Clans, and battle challenging bosses.

items.question: How do I redeem Project Slayers codes?
items.answer: In Project Slayers, open the in-game menu by pressing M, click the Twitter bird / gift icon, paste your working code, and press Submit to claim free spins and Wen.

items.question: Which is better in Project Slayers: Slayer or Demon?
items.answer: Both paths are viable in Project Slayers. Slayers utilize swords and diverse Breathing Styles, while Demons rely on Blood Demon Arts and health regeneration, but take damage from sunlight.

items.question: How do I unlock a Breathing Style in Project Slayers?
items.answer: To learn a Breathing Style in Project Slayers, reach level 12, save 5,000 Wen, purchase and train with gourds, and visit the respective style trainer on the map to complete their training trials.

items.question: What are the best Clans in Project Slayers?
items.answer: The best Clans in Project Slayers are Supreme tier families like Kamado and Agatsuma, which provide unique abilities, passive stat boosts, and stamina efficiency.
